usage: llm-modelbench campaign supersede [-h] --campaign-id CAMPAIGN_ID
                                         [--source-campaign-id SOURCE_CAMPAIGN_ID]
                                         [--source-run-id SOURCE_RUN_ID]
                                         [--source-row SOURCE_ROW]
                                         [--source-row-hash SOURCE_ROW_HASH]
                                         [--replacement-campaign-id REPLACEMENT_CAMPAIGN_ID]
                                         --replacement-run-id REPLACEMENT_RUN_ID
                                         --replacement-row REPLACEMENT_ROW
                                         [--replacement-row-hash REPLACEMENT_ROW_HASH]
                                         --reason REASON [--operator OPERATOR]
                                         [--dry-run]

Append one schema-versioned source-to-replacement evidence edge. The source
hash must identify primary evidence; forks, cycles, unsupported schemas, and
hash/provenance contradictions fail closed.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --campaign-id CAMPAIGN_ID
  --source-campaign-id SOURCE_CAMPAIGN_ID
  --source-run-id SOURCE_RUN_ID
  --source-row SOURCE_ROW
                        JSON file used only to derive/confirm the immutable
                        source row hash
  --source-row-hash SOURCE_ROW_HASH
                        immutable source row hash from campaign primary
                        evidence
  --replacement-campaign-id REPLACEMENT_CAMPAIGN_ID
  --replacement-run-id REPLACEMENT_RUN_ID
  --replacement-row REPLACEMENT_ROW
                        JSON file containing the corrected row
  --replacement-row-hash REPLACEMENT_ROW_HASH
                        expected corrected row hash
  --reason REASON
  --operator OPERATOR
  --dry-run             validate and preview without appending
